entries.english:
Adolf Rosenberg’s compensation claims

Contains: 1930 copy concerning the value in 1911 of the hereditary estate “Kempers Kolonat” in Ahlen; Adolf Rosenberg’s statement that he received a loan from Hugo Hertz, pledging mortgage certificates registered in his name; receipt for a mortgage certificate; correspondence between Adolf Rosenberg and his lawyer in Ahlen; notice from lawyer Ludwig Kaufmann that the Foreign Exchange Office refused to register an assigned owner’s mortgage; correspondence between Franz Branse and Adolf Rosenberg.

Contains: application for compensation under the Federal Compensation Act; copies relating to the Act; newspaper article on pension entitlement for occupational damage, c. 1971; investigation report on the compensation application; statement of profits from the Rosenberg grain and feed business, 1925–1934; affidavit by Adolf Rosenberg; compensation settlement.
